messages.content: how plants drnk water
You want to know how plants drink water. Roots take in water from the soil, and it moves up the stem to the leaves. Tiny hairs on the roots help absorb it.
wat is difernce between tenis and badminton

You want to know the difference between tennis and badminton. Tennis uses a rubber ball and strung racket on a larger court, while badminton uses a light shuttle and a lighter racket. Badminton is often played indoors.
wat to say in job interviw
You want to know what to say in a job interview. Greet politely, speak clearly about your skills and give honest examples. Learn about the company beforehand, and ask one question at the end.
brinjal turns black after cuting how stop
You're asking how to keep cut brinjal from turning black. Put the pieces in water with a little salt or lemon juice until you are ready to cook them.
how to cut watermelon in smal pieces without mess
You want to cut watermelon into small pieces without a mess. Cut off both ends, stand it up and slice off the rind in strips. Then cut the fruit into slices and then into cubes.
how to explane kids why onion make us cry
You want to explain to children why onions make us cry. When you cut an onion, it lets out a gas into the air that stings the eyes. The eyes make tears to wash it away.
guests comin tomorow, wat simple snaks can i make
You want simple snacks to make for guests tomorrow. Try vegetable sandwiches, poha, or baked samosas, with chutney and tea. They are quick and easy to make in bulk.
how long iron bok take 2 heet
You're asking how long an iron takes to heat. I don't know for your model. It usually takes a couple of minutes, and many have a light that tells you when it is ready.
rice is undercok wat to do
You want to fix undercooked rice. Add a few spoons of hot water, cover the pot, and cook on low heat for five more minutes until it is soft.
is it fine to use same cuting board for veg and meet
You're asking whether one cutting board can be used for vegetables and meat. It is safer to use two separate boards, or to wash the board well with hot soapy water between uses.
wats the capital of the state were my aunty lives
You want the capital of the state where your aunt lives. I don't know, because I don't know which state she lives in. Please ask your family for the state's name.
pls tell me hw to make soft cake without oven
You want to bake a soft cake without an oven. Pour the batter in a greased tin, place it in a covered heavy pot over low heat, and bake for about forty minutes. Check with a toothpick.
hw to say sorry to granny for breaking her glass
You want to say sorry to your grandmother for breaking her glass. Tell her honestly, "I'm sorry, Granny. It slipped from my hand." Offer to clean it, and ask what you can do to help.
how do i make my parnts bday speshal wit smal budjet
You want to make your parents' birthday special on a small budget. Make a card, cook a favourite dish, and decorate a room with paper. Write down what you love about them.
wat is electrisity
You want to know what electricity is. Electricity is a flow of tiny charged particles, usually through a wire. It can make light, heat and movement in machines.
name of the smalest hill near my villag plz
You want the name of the smallest hill near your village. I don't know that, because I can't see your area. A local elder, a teacher or a local map would be the best help.
wat is a solor panel
You're asking what a solar panel is. A solar panel is a flat board that turns sunlight into electricity. People use it to run lights, fans and many other things.
wat doc i need for aadhar update
You're asking which documents you need to update your Aadhaar details. I can't be sure of the current list. The official Aadhaar website or a nearby enrolment centre will tell you.
who to ask for recomendation leter
You're asking who to ask for a recommendation letter. Teachers or managers who know your work well are good choices. Ask politely and give them a few weeks and a short note about your goals.
wat is viva in college
You're asking what a viva is in college. It is an oral exam where a teacher asks you questions about your subject or project. Preparing short answers about your own work helps.
